<?php
class QuietMethodStaticCVTarget { public static function counter() { static $counter = 0; $counter = $counter + 1; return $counter; } }
class QuietMethodStaticCVEmptyGet {
    private int $value = 41;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): object { global $reader, $selector, $held; echo "G;"; $saved = $held; $held = null; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; return $saved; }
    public function __destruct() { global $watch; echo "RECEIVER;"; echo $watch->get() === null ? "WRAPPER_GONE;" : "BAD_WRAPPER;";  }
}
$held = QuietMethodStaticCVTarget::counter(...);
echo QuietMethodStaticCVTarget::counter() === 1 ? "WARM;" : "BAD_WARM;";
$watch = WeakReference::create($held);
$reader = new QuietMethodStaticCVEmptyGet;
$readerWeak = WeakReference::create($reader);
$selector = "value";
$destination = 42;
$destination = empty($reader->$selector);
echo $destination === false ? "FALSE;" : "BAD_EMPTY;";
echo $held === null && $reader === null && $selector === "changed" ? "CAPTURE;" : "BAD_CAPTURE;";
echo $readerWeak->get() === null ? "RECEIVER_GONE;" : "BAD_OWNER;";
echo QuietMethodStaticCVTarget::counter() === 2 ? "STATIC;" : "BAD_STATIC;";
$watch = null;
$readerWeak = null;
echo "DONE;";

}
$held = QuietMethodStaticLiteralTarget::counter(...);
echo QuietMethodStaticLiteralTarget::counter() === 1 ? "WARM;" : "BAD_WARM;";

$destination = 42;
try { $destination = empty($reader->value); echo "BAD_DELIVERY;"; }
catch (Exception $failure) { echo "CAUGHT;"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_DESTINATION;";
echo $held === null && $reader === null && $selector === "changed" ? "CAPTURE;" : "BAD_CAPTURE;";
echo $readerWeak->get() === null ? "RECEIVER_GONE;" : "BAD_OWNER;";
echo QuietMethodStaticLiteralTarget::counter() === 2 ? "STATIC;" : "BAD_STATIC;";

$readerWeak = null;
echo "DONE;";
